svg.title: Reading a phase difference as probability
svg.desc: Ideal one-qubit H–Rz(pi)–H calculation. Complex amplitudes, Bloch vectors and Z-measurement probabilities are shown after each gate. The Bloch sphere is a state representation.
svg.metadata: {"calculation": "Review ideal statevector calculation", "phi_rad": 3.141592653589793, "sources": ["https://quantum.cloud.ibm.com/docs/en/api/qiskit/qiskit.circuit.library.RZGate"], "stages": ["H", "Rz(phi)", "H"], "amplitude_scale": "Arrow radius corresponds to amplitude magnitude 1; real right, imaginary up."}
svg.text: Reading a phase difference as probability
|0⟩ → H → Rz(φ) → H φ = π rad
Arrows: complex amplitudes · Bars: Z probabilities
Bloch sphere: a representation of quantum state
Review ideal educational calculation · angles in rad
